title: Set 217

sentences.ko: 저기요, 히터 때문에 또 연락드려요. 아직도 밤마다 쾅쾅거리는 소리가 나는데요, 지난주에 보내 주신 기사님이 부품을 새로 갈아야 한다고 하셨거든요. 그 부품 대체 언제쯤 오는지 아세요?
sentences.text: Hey, it's me again about the heater. It's still making that banging noise at night, and the guy you sent last week said it needs a new part, so do you know when that's actually coming?

alts.text: Me again about the heater. It's still banging all night, and your guy last week said it needs a new part. Any idea when that's actually showing up?

Hello, I am contacting you again regarding the heater. It is still making a banging noise at night, and the technician you sent last week said that it requires a new part. Do you know when that part will arrive?

sentences.note: **it's me again** 은 같은 일로 또 연락할 때 쓰는 말로, 또 저예요 정도의 느낌입니다. **the guy you sent** 는 보내 주신 사람이라는 뜻으로, 수리 기사를 편하게 부르는 말입니다.
sentences.situation: 집주인이랑 고장 난 것 고쳐 달라고 얘기하기

sentences.ko: 음, 걔가 처음에는 좀 조용한데, 편해지면 진짜 웃겨. 근데 전 여자친구 얘기만 꺼내지 마. 아직 그 얘기 나오면 좀 이상해지거든.
sentences.text: Okay, so he's kind of quiet at first, but once he gets comfortable he's really funny. Just don't bring up his ex, because he's still a little weird about it.

alts.text: Kinda quiet at first, but super funny once he warms up. Just don't mention the ex, he's still weird about that.
He is rather quiet at first, but once he feels comfortable, he is very funny. Please do not mention his former partner, because he is still somewhat uncomfortable about it.

sentences.note: **bring up** 은 어떤 이야기를 꺼내다라는 뜻입니다. **once he gets comfortable** 은 일단 편해지면이라는 뜻으로, once 가 ~하기만 하면의 뜻으로 쓰였습니다.
sentences.situation: 친구 소개팅 주선하면서 상대가 어떤 사람인지 설명하기

sentences.ko: 그 피자집 예전에 엄청 맛있었던 거 기억나? 지난주에 다시 가 봤는데 아무 맛도 안 나더라. 요리사가 바뀌었거나 뭐 그런 것 같아.
sentences.text: Remember how good that pizza place used to be? I went back last week and it just didn't taste like anything, so I'm pretty sure they got a new cook or something.

alts.text: You know that pizza place that used to be so good? Went back last week and it was totally bland. Pretty sure they've got a new cook or something.
Do you remember how good that pizza restaurant used to be? I returned last week and the food had no flavor at all, so I am fairly certain they have hired a new cook.

sentences.note: **didn't taste like anything** 은 아무 맛도 안 났다는 뜻입니다. **or something** 은 말끝에 붙여 확실하지 않을 때 쓰는 말로, ~거나 뭐 그런 거 정도의 느낌입니다.

sentences.ko: 오늘 아침에 수업 가려고 준비 다 해 놨는데, 딱 나가려는 참에 개가 러그에 토했어. 그거 다 치우고 나니까 이미 수업 놓쳤더라.
sentences.text: I was all set to go to my class this morning, but the dog threw up on the rug right as I was leaving, and by the time I cleaned it up, I'd already missed it.

alts.text: Totally meant to hit class this morning, but the dog puked on the rug just as I was heading out. Cleaned it up and boom, missed it.
I was fully prepared to attend my class this morning, but the dog vomited on the rug just as I was leaving, and by the time I had cleaned it, I had already missed the class.

sentences.note: **all set** 은 준비가 다 됐다는 뜻입니다. **right as I was leaving** 은 막 나가려던 참에라는 뜻이고, **by the time** 은 ~할 즈음에는 이미라는 뜻입니다.
sentences.situation: 운동 가려다 말게 된 핑계 대기

sentences.ko: 요즘 계란값 봤어? 어제 열두 개에 거의 7달러 줬어. 진짜 얼마 전까지만 해도 2달러쯤이었던 것 같은데. 요즘 다들 어떻게 가족 먹여 살리는지 모르겠어.
sentences.text: Have you seen what eggs cost now? I paid almost seven dollars for a dozen yesterday, and I swear they were like two bucks not that long ago. I don't know how anybody's feeding a family right now.

alts.text: Seen egg prices lately? Almost seven bucks for a dozen yesterday, and I swear they were like two bucks not long ago. No idea how anyone's feeding a family right now.

Have you noticed what eggs cost now? I paid almost seven dollars for a dozen yesterday, and I am certain they were about two dollars not long ago. I do not know how anyone is managing to feed a family at the moment.

sentences.note: **bucks** 는 dollars 를 편하게 부르는 말입니다. **I swear** 는 진짜로, 맹세코라는 뜻으로 말을 힘주어 할 때 씁니다. 참고로 **a dozen** 은 열두 개입니다.

reviewed: 1번 한국어: actually 의 답답한 느낌이 '실제로'로 번역투가 되어 '대체 언제쯤'으로 고침
2번 casual: text 와 앞부분(he's kind of quiet at first)이 거의 같아 더 짧은 구어로 바꿈
4번 casual: I was totally ready 가 text 의 I was all set 과 같은 틀이라 다르게 고침
5번 한국어: 한국에서 계란 한 판은 30개라 a dozen(12개)과 안 맞음. '열두 개에'로 고침
